Callout.Name: Fuel Theft - Remote Station
Callout.Message: Fuel taken from a station with nobody on site.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle at the pump with covered plates.

Script.Line: The pump runs on a card and I have got a card.
The tape on the plate is from a repair. Ask any garage.
I have paid for the fuel. Look at the receipt.

Lines.Approach: Nobody on site, plates covered with tape, and the pump is still running.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
